plugins.description: Syncs PublicMetaDB lists into Vio as zero-storage virtual movies and series with full episode metadata. Playback is delegated to Vio's virtual stream provider (Vio Virtual Library + AIOStreams).
plugins.name: PMDB Lists (Vio)

plugins.description: Browsable pages for PublicMetaDB lists inside Silo, with TMDB posters and badges showing which titles are already in your Silo libraries. Silo's plugin API cannot add library items, so this is a discovery view; the companion Vio plugin turns the same lists into playable libraries.
plugins.name: PMDB Lists (Silo)
